title: Require positive mobility as well as stable partial refresh
statement: The exact partial-refresh cell has Delta A+k^T Delta z=R mu F+sqrt(R)sigma zeta, mu=(1-r)[2/g+b cot(theta/2)]^2/[2(1+r)] and sigma^2=2mu. Compact positive-response bounds suffice without learning k or mu. Stable theta=3pi/2,g=1,b=2,r=0 has zero sustained mobility and is excluded. Actual delayed force work retains an exponentially small old-state correlation; vanishing rare-armed mean force work does not pay continuing thermal/source/sensor costs.
